changelog: Fix: sidebar nav and the bottom balance/user block now share a single scroll region — on a short desktop viewport (confirmed at 1366x590, the reported real-world case) the v3.9.0 fix left nav scrollable in principle but squeezed to a sliver with no visible affordance while the balance card stayed pinned at fixed height; now everything scrolls together and nothing is unreachable, on both the desktop and mobile-drawer layout branches

Fix: Win Rate by Fib Level (dashboard chart) and By Fib Level (Statistics table) no longer render a bucket's win rate with full confidence when it's based on a handful of trades — buckets now carry based_on_n/conclusive same as ReviewEngineController's early-signal convention, low-n buckets are visually muted/marked '*' instead of looking as confident as a real sample, n is always shown

Investigated: the Fib breakdown's data source (trades.fib_level), closed-trades filter, and active-challenge scope were already correct as of v3.9.0 — the 0%/100% buckets were a real small-sample artifact, not a scoping or query bug. Confirmed live 2026-09-14: only 8 of 26 closed trades carry a fib_level (0.382 n=4/0%, 0.5 n=2/0%, 0.618 n=1/100%); a cross-join against trade_variables variable 14 never overlaps and would only take the chart from 7 to 8 usable trades, so reconciling the two sources was deliberately not attempted here (see CLAUDE.md)
